cards.title: Supporting a Pregnant Friend When You're Not Good With Babies
cards.body: You don't need to be naturally gifted with babies to be a good friend during pregnancy. Eleanor Gordon-Smith explains that every child is different, and you'll discover your connection once you meet them.

cards.title: Should You Move Back Home Before Your Daughter Starts School?
cards.body: Relocating closer to family offers support but comes with its own costs beyond finances. The advice column weighs proximity to relatives against the time needed to build new friendships in your current location.

cards.title: Parenting Adult Children: When Your Graduate Moves Back Home
cards.body: Adult children returning to the family nest requires adjusting parenting styles and expectations. Emma Beddington explores the new dynamics when a graduate moves back after university.

cards.title: Is It OK to Leave Young Children to Pursue Adventures?
cards.body: Emma Beddington questions whether parents should prioritize wilderness expeditions and world travel over family responsibilities. The piece examines the ethics of leaving small children while pursuing personal goals.

cards.title: The Difficulty of Twin Estrangement
cards.body: Raising twins requires intentional focus on individual development to prevent estrangement later. Without proper attention to their separate identities, twins may struggle with their relationship in adulthood.

cards.title: What Young Adults Want Parents to Know
cards.body: Young adults today face unique challenges including climate change, AI, and social media pressures that differ from previous generations. They may struggle to communicate their feelings about this uncertainty to their parents.

cards.title: Why Reconciliation With Family Members Fails
cards.body: Family reconciliation succeeds less through words and more through emotional presence and dropping unrealistic expectations. Psychology research shows defensiveness is the key barrier to healing family relationships.

cards.title: Emotional Regulation: Why It Matters for Parents
cards.body: Parenting evokes some of life's biggest and most complicated emotions that directly impact family mental health. Understanding emotional regulation helps parents navigate the complex feelings parenthood brings.
